batch.topic: A colleague sits on an unanswered request despite having received it; idiom concerns delayed action, not bodily position.
A speaker cannot put their finger on why an argument seems weak; idiom concerns identification, not touching a document.
A person keeps an eye on a changing schedule and asks to be told of a confirmed change; monitoring is not a literal instruction about eyes.
A team joins forces on one task while retaining separate responsibilities for another; cooperation does not merge all roles.
